welcome.title: ✨ {store_name} ✨
welcome.subtitle:
Hey {name}! 👋

Welcome to your premium digital-product store. We're thrilled to have you here!

🛍️ Browse our exclusive collection
📦 Track your orders in real-time
💬 Get instant support when you need it
🎁 Enjoy special offers and rewards

Pick an option below to get started.
welcome.community: ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 👥 Join our official group 👉 {group_url} New drops, restocks and offers are posted there first, and you can see real buyers vouch before you order. Tap the link above or use the Join Our Group button below. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

gift.prompt: 🎁 Free Gift Have a gift code? Send it here and its value will be added to your wallet instantly. ✏️ Type your code below:
gift.default_description: Claim your free gift and add instant credit to your wallet!
gift.invalid_code: 📭 No gifts available right now We don't have any active gifts at the moment, but we're always adding new rewards and special offers! Check back soon — and keep an eye on your notifications so you don't miss the next one. 🎁
gift.not_active: 📭 No gifts available right now We don't have any active gifts at the moment, but we're always adding new rewards and special offers! Check back soon — and keep an eye on your notifications so you don't miss the next one. 🎁
gift.expired: 📭 No gifts available right now We don't have any active gifts at the moment, but we're always adding new rewards and special offers! Check back soon — and keep an eye on your notifications so you don't miss the next one. 🎁
gift.exhausted: 📭 No gifts available right now We don't have any active gifts at the moment, but we're always adding new rewards and special offers! Check back soon — and keep an eye on your notifications so you don't miss the next one. 🎁
gift.limit_reached: You've already claimed this gift! 😊 We'll notify you when new gifts are available.
gift.redeemed: 🎉 Gift claimed! 💰 {amount} has been added to your wallet. It's ready to spend right now — head to 🛍️ Products and pick something up, or keep it for later. Your balance is always in 👤 Profile. Thanks for being here. More gifts drop from time to time, so keep notifications on. 🎁
gift.grants_item: 🎁 You get: one gift item, delivered instantly.
gift.redeemed_item: 🎉 It's yours! Here's your gift — copy it somewhere safe: {payload} ⚠️ This is shown once. We can't display it again, so save it before you leave this screen. Something not working? 💬 Live Chat will sort you out. Thanks for being here — more gifts drop from time to time, so keep notifications on. 🎁

support.menu: 💬 Live Chat Need help with an order, a payment, or your wallet? Our team is here for you. 🎫 Create Ticket — describe your issue and we'll get back to you. 📋 My Tickets — check replies and the status of your past tickets. ⏱️ Typical reply time: within a few hours.
support.choose_category: Choose a category for your ticket:
support.created: ✅ Ticket {ticket_number} opened. Just reply here to chat with support — we'll get back to you soon.
support.created_undelivered: ⚠️ Ticket {ticket_number} was saved, but we couldn't reach our support team just now. It is not lost — we'll pick it up as soon as the connection is back.
support.ticket_closed: This ticket is closed. Open a new one if you still need help.
support.no_tickets: 📋 MY TICKETS You haven't opened any tickets yet. When something goes wrong with an order, a payment, or your wallet, open a ticket from 💬 Live Chat and it will show up here with our replies.
support.tickets_title: 📋 MY TICKETS Every ticket you've opened with us, newest first. Tap one to read the conversation and see where it stands. 🟢 Open 🟡 Waiting on us 🔵 Resolved ⚫ Closed 💬 Open tickets keep going — just reply in the chat to add to one.
support.ticket_hint_open: ✍️ Reply here in the chat and your message goes straight to our team — no need to open a second ticket.
support.ticket_hint_closed: 🔒 This ticket is closed, so replies won't reach us. Open a fresh one from 💬 Live Chat if you still need a hand.
support.system_unavailable: ⚠️ There's a temporary issue with the support system. Our admin is working to fix it — please try again later.
support.blocked_by_ticket: You already have an open ticket ({reference}). Just reply here to continue it — we handle one at a time, and you can open a new one once this is closed.
support.blocked_by_warranty: Your warranty claim ({reference}) is still under review. We handle one request at a time — once it's resolved you can open a new ticket.
support.blocked_by_order: Your order dispute ({reference}) is still open — just type your message here and it goes straight to the team handling it. We keep it to one conversation at a time, so nothing else opens until they close it.
support.dispute_closed_notice:
🔒 Your order dispute has been closed by our team.

💬 Live Chat is open to you again — if anything about the refund is still unresolved, open a ticket there and we'll pick it up.

orders.manual_pending: 🙋 Being prepared Our team is getting your item ready and will deliver it right here. You can track it under 📦 Orders.
orders.empty_history: 📦 MY ORDERS 🛍️ No purchases yet! Browse our store to find amazing products and make your first purchase today. Your orders will appear here once you buy something.
orders.history_title: 📦 MY ORDERS Everything you've bought from us, newest first. Tap any order to see what was in it, what you paid, and how it was delivered. 🟢 Completed 🔵 Processing 🟡 Pending 🔴 Cancelled 🛡️ Items that came with a warranty are tracked under 🔧 Warranty.
orders.detail_history: 📜 History — quote any ID below and we'll find it instantly
orders.refund_parked: 💸 {amount} is held in your Refund Balance. It's kept separately from your spendable wallet while our team settles it with you — so it isn't shop credit unless you ask for it to be.
orders.refund_crypto_note: 💎 You paid for this on chain, so we can't reverse it automatically. Reply in the ticket below with the BEP-20 (BSC) address you'd like the refund sent to.
orders.refund_ticket: 🎫 Ticket {ticket_number} is open for this refund — just reply in the chat.
orders.detail_hint: 🧾 Keep this order number handy — quoting it in 💬 Live Chat is the fastest way for us to find your purchase.

refunds.title: ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 💸 MY REFUNDS ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
refunds.empty:
🎉 You have no refunds.

If an order of yours is ever declined, the money comes here first — you'll see the amount, which order it was, and why, before anything else happens to it.
refunds.crypto_hint: 💎 You paid on chain, so reply in the ticket with the BEP-20 address you want it sent to.
refunds.ticket: 🎫 Ticket {ticket_number} — reply there and it reaches us.
refunds.refund_row_parked: +{amount} came in from a declined order
refunds.footer_pending: This money is held for you and kept apart from your spendable balance, so it can't be spent by accident while we sort it out. Our team will either send it to you or move it into your balance — ask in 💬 Live Chat if you'd prefer one over the other.
refunds.footer_clear: Everything owed to you has been settled. Nothing is outstanding.
